Long name: KLIEN renewable energy potentials for Austria
Description: Municipality-level GeoJSON data and derived NUTS3 CSVs for photovoltaic and onshore wind potentials in Austria. The study provides technical and realisable potentials by year, ambition level and climate scenario.
Owner: Austrian Climate and Energy Fund (KLIEN); AIT; Environment Agency Austria; TU Wien; AEE INTEC; Energiewerkstatt

Description: Useful energy demand by energy carrier, sector and Nutzenergiekategorie for each Austrian Bundesland. PyPSA-AT retrieves the Statistik Austria ODS workbooks and combines them into the regional NEA input.
License: Source terms not specified; see the source website

Description: AT-specific OpenStreetMap electricity-network data with Austrian filtering and recovered operator/frequency attributes. The archive contains the custom AT snapshot used by the default workflow; the build mode recreates it from raw OSM data.
License: ODbL-1.0 for OSM data; see archive metadata for derived-data terms

Description: Existing Austrian electricity-generating plants using biogas, landfill gas or sewage gas, including capacity and postal code. PyPSA-AT adds these plants to the brownfield powerplant table.
Mapping of Austrian postal codes to NUTS3 regions used to locate Anlagenregister power plants in the model.

AGGM-provided Austrian gas-network brownfield data at AT10 and AT35 resolution, including regional transport corridors and capacities. Pipeline diameters are intentionally omitted for confidentiality reasons.
License: Internal AGGM data; redistribution subject to AGGM permission

Long name: Austrian and European gas-storage capacity compilation
Description: Curated storage capacities used to replace freely extendable gas stores. Austrian site data comes from storage operators and AGGM aggregation; European values use AGSI or SciGRID-based estimates as documented in the source file.
Owner: AGGM; RAG; OMV; SEFE; UNIPER; Gas Infrastructure Europe
License: Mixed; see the individual source terms

Description: Manually documented exceptions for Austrian regional electricity-grid feeds, based on OSM topology and Austrian distribution-system operator network development plans. These overrides keep supply connections for regions without a high-voltage substation.
License: Mixed; see the cited source evidence

Description: PEMMDB, hydro inflows, electricity and hydrogen reference grids, investment datasets and hydrogen import data consumed by the AT-specific capacity, inflow and transmission trajectory scripts.
License: MIT for the Open-TYNDP tooling; source-data terms apply

Description: Gas-system capacity data used to set the residual Trans-Anatolia Gas Pipeline capacity when modelling the Russian gas import blockade.
Owner: European Network of Transmission System Operators for Gas (ENTSOG)
License: For information only; not intended for commercial use
